name: Shenzhen Dorabot Inc.
summary: Dorabot develops intelligent robotic manipulators and related intelligent hardware systems. Its research includes artificial intelligence learning, machine vision, tactile perception, autonomous navigation, multi-robot collaboration and manipulation on mobile platforms.
